class.name: SortedListCallback
class.brief_description: Compares items and receives SortedList change events.
class.description: SortedListCallback is the port of [i]SortedList.Callback[/i]. Subclass it to define item ordering ([method _compare]), identity ([method _are_items_the_same]) and content equality ([method _are_contents_the_same]) for a [b]SortedList[/b], and to consume the emitted insert / remove / move / change events.

method.name: _are_contents_the_same
method.description: Returns whether two items have identical content.

method.name: _are_items_the_same
method.description: Returns whether two items represent the same data.

method.name: _compare
method.description: Returns < 0 when [code]a[/code] sorts before [code]b[/code], > 0 when after, 0 when equal.

method.name: _on_changed_with_payload
method.description: Called when an item changed with a payload.

method.name: _on_inserted
method.description: Called when an item was inserted.

method.name: _on_removed
method.description: Called when an item was removed.
